qualified_boundary: Only the enumerated fixtures, modes, provider identities and supplied capabilities. No complete utility or full-system qualification.

Darwin.gencat/stdin-stdout: Apple gencat rejects the required '-' stream operands. Strict reproducer retained by --scope all.
Darwin.iconv/invalid-policy: Apple iconv writes the invalid-character diagnostic with -s. Strict reproducer retained by --scope all.
Darwin.gencat/unknown-escape: Apple gencat diagnoses a valid unrecognized escape but returns success, violating XCU 1.4 STDERR. Output q remains required in the strict reproducer.

Linux.gencat/merge-replace-delete: glibc gencat retains a set deleted from an existing catalog by $delset. Strict assertion still requires deletion.
Linux.iconv/invalid-policy: glibc iconv emits an invalid-character diagnostic despite -s. Strict assertion still requires no stderr.

gencat: Default NL_SETD, implementation limits and I/O or allocation exhaustion; diagnostic locales; native stream operands
gettext: Catalog search permutations beyond the supplied domains/locales; translated diagnostics; output failures and resource ceilings
ngettext: Additional plural expressions and integer boundaries; catalog search and diagnostic permutations; output failures and resource ceilings
msgfmt: Additional format checks, LC_CTYPE charset fallback, no-c-format precedence, diagnostic locales, output failures and resource ceilings
iconv: Charmap joins, exhaustive advertised encodings, invalid-character option policy, interrupted I/O and resource ceilings
locale: Complete keyword/category value and quoting grammar, listing completeness against vendor databases, diagnostics and output failures
localedef: Darwin generated categories beyond LC_NUMERIC and charmaps; public-locale installation; -c warning retention, -u, all category grammar, limits and fault atomicity; category success reporting
